idea-plugin.name: Cyclone
idea-plugin.description:
The Cyclone plugin for IntelliJ allows you to customize the progress bar during project indexing to your liking with Cyclone!.

Important: It is recommended to avoid having other plugins that change the progress bar in order to prevent conflicts.

Features:

  • You can customize both the forward and backward progress bar images.
  • You can change the progress bar using popular image formats such as .gif, .png, .jpg, and .jpeg.
  • You can see which image you have selected, on the current forward or backward image preview.
  • Cyclone brings 2 default images ready to use.
  • Reset buttons to quickly return to default cyclone images.
  • To ensure a better appearance of the progress bar, the image size should be 32x32 or smaller.

How to use:

  • Go to File > Settings > Editor > Cyclone
  • Click "Browse..." next to "Forward Image" to select the image for rightward progress movement.
  • Click "Browse..." next to "Backward Image" to select the image for leftward progress movement.
  • Use "Reset to Default" buttons to restore original cyclone images.
  • Click "Apply" button to save changes.
  • Click "OK" button - changes apply instantly!

Bug or Suggestions:

  • You can report a bug by creating an issue on the repository.
  • You can suggest a feature by creating an issue on the repository.
